description: Save the active document to disk. Path must be absolute; the parent directory must exist. Supported formats: c4d (default), abc / alembic, fbx, obj, stl, ply, usd / usda, gltf. With `copy:true` the document's internal name/path is left unchanged (Save-As-Copy behaviour).

copy.description: Save as copy — document's active path/name stays unchanged. Default false.

name: save_document
title: Save Document
